# Retained House capture and review inputs

The hash-named members are exact retained capture inputs and bounded source-review
evidence for House Document 110-106 Part I, physical page 49 (printed page 37).
`selection.json` pins each member and the complete original PDF. The tests relocate
the small retained members by hash; they do not download or synthesize the original.

These tests exercise offline capture replay, processing-input closure and exact
typed-page reconstruction. Independent original-image and final Parquet/MCP checks
remain separate retained campaign evidence. The bounded review does not qualify
all text or office/account continuity, and the output preserves those limitations.
